verdict.rationale: Postman offers some event-driven building blocks — webhooks for event-driven integrations (postman-docs-24), pre-request/post-response scripts that fire on request events (postman-docs-12), and CI/CD-triggered collection runs (postman-docs-19) — but there's no documented rule-engine or 'if event X then action Y' automation framework comparable to a dedicated automation-depth feature. Missing for 10: a first-class rules/triggers UI or API, examples of arbitrary event-to-action bindings beyond request lifecycle hooks, and independent confirmation of this being used for autonomous event-driven automation.
